purpose: P0.1/B02 baseline inventory; not a runtime tool schema or a certification list.

statusDefinitions.working: Verified for the explicitly stated scope; does not imply a complete game workflow.
statusDefinitions.partial: Implemented in part, with a concrete known limitation.
statusDefinitions.experimental: Source exists, but semantic and end-to-end behavior is not certified.
statusDefinitions.broken: A specific advertised outcome is contradicted by current implementation or a reproduced failure.
statusDefinitions.absent: Required functionality has no implementation in the inspected path.

methodology: Behavior union includes inspector catalog entries and literal b.type equality branches in both runtimes.
AI inventory includes literal executor switch cases and numbered system-prompt action declarations.
UI inventory includes every UI module and literal button/input/select/textarea/anchor opening tag. Dynamic IDs and templates are retained as patterns, not expanded instances.
Source scanners are conservative inventory aids, not JavaScript parsers. Computed dispatch, programmatic controls and semantic correctness require manual review.
Test mentions are literal name references only, not test execution, coverage or proof of gameplay.
Persistence is evaluated separately from source/runtime presence. No behavior is certified merely because generic properties serialize.
Explicit reviews override conservative experimental defaults. Runtime certification remains a P6/P7 task.

features.name: Scene hierarchy and transforms
features.editor: Selection, creation, parenting, transforms and gizmos exist.
features.persistence: Local transforms and entity IDs now round-trip; full component coverage and name-reference migration remain pending.
features.export: Separate generated loader; parity unverified.
features.next: Round-trip nested transforms; validate parenting and undo.
features.proof: Nested transforms and generated-game reconstruction pass; native tag handling and resource duplication are tested without blank-entity fallback. Explicit editor-only helpers are excluded from saved content and survive scene replacement.

features.name: Simple and Pro modes
features.editor: Inspector/mode controls exist; both still use the dense editor.
features.persistence: No project conversion is necessary; UI preference is separate.
features.export: Editor-only capability.
features.next: Build chat-and-preview Simple layout against the same project.
features.proof: Source review; end-to-end certification pending.

features.name: Complete project save/open
features.editor: Versioned full-project Save/Open is wired; File open awaits active-scene model and material-texture loads.
features.persistence: All scenes, shared script source, IDs, selected settings, asset/prefab records and supported scene data round-trip.
features.export: Optional portable JSON embeds declared media and standard glTF dependencies; complete archive/runtime and arbitrary-script dependencies remain open.
features.next: Complete component/resource fields, dependency packaging and atomic native file saving; local recovery foundation now exists.
features.proof: Fresh-editor multi-scene round trips and invalid-import preservation pass in project-document tests.

features.name: Autosave and crash recovery
features.editor: Local IndexedDB autosnapshots, recovery picker, dirty/download state and unsaved-close guards are implemented.
features.persistence: Up to five snapshots per project and twenty overall; writes/pruning are transactional. Recovery inherits version 1 serialization limits.
features.export: Not applicable.
features.next: Atomic native file writes, pre-AI checkpoints, complete resource coverage and packaged crash/large-project verification.
features.proof: Controller regression tests and real Chromium IndexedDB tests cover persistence, retention, aborted-write preservation, restore and failure states.

features.name: Multiple scenes
features.editor: In-memory create/switch/rename/duplicate/delete exists.
features.persistence: Scene collection, active scene and stable scene IDs persist in the new project format.
features.export: Exporter reads active scene; full scene delivery unresolved.
features.next: Certify runtime transitions and delivery of every scene; migrate name references.
features.proof: Project tests reopen and switch scenes, retain global scripts and check rename/duplicate identity.

features.name: Universal undo/redo
features.editor: Create/delete and some component edits use command history.
features.persistence: History is not a durable task journal.
features.export: Editor-only.
features.next: Awaited mixed-operation transactions and whole-prompt rollback.
features.proof: Source shows modify_entity mutating transforms directly; prior targeted check confirmed no added undo entry.

features.name: Isolated play sessions
features.editor: Editor-owned Play/Stop runs disposable same-application scene copies; original scene objects, selection, camera orbit and history are restored on Stop.
features.persistence: Editable saves and scene replacement are blocked during Play; runtime changes do not enter authoring history or recovery.
features.export: Separate runtime implementation.
features.next: Separate preview application/security context; configured game camera/input, shared gameplay runtime and arbitrary code/resource isolation.
features.proof: Eight controller/real-engine regressions and fourteen real-browser button/Ammo/GLB assertions cover the declared restoration scope.

features.name: GLB models and animation
features.editor: Bundled model catalog and GLB loading/animation setup exist.
features.persistence: Generated instance children excluded; completed local-import aliases can persist as embedded model URLs.
features.export: Referenced paths and model resources need portable collection.
features.next: Extend readiness to all required resource types and certify animated/textured models and offline dependencies.
features.proof: Source review; end-to-end certification pending.

features.name: PBR materials and texture maps
features.editor: Material editing and preview exist.
features.persistence: Diffuse/normal/roughness/emissive references now round-trip and load; full material/UV/channel coverage remains open.
features.export: Exported scene builder loads all four supported texture-map slots; complete dependency packaging and visual certification remain pending.
features.next: Complete material/texture schema and dependency collection.
features.proof: Real engine NullGraphicsDevice tests verify saved texture references and editor/export property binding, not final visual quality.

features.name: Procedural terrain
features.editor: Final-grid terrain generation, real image heightmap decoding, undoable creation and independent duplication exist.
features.persistence: Versioned final height samples reconstruct the mesh, collision source and static body; malformed grids are rejected.
features.export: The shared mesh builder reconstructs saved terrain in delivered scenes; full Ammo/play/visual certification remains pending.
features.next: Verify Ammo contacts, traversal, large terrains and full prefab/resource workflows.
features.proof: Real engine mesh/position/collision-source and exported-builder tests pass; three real-browser PNG decode/error checks pass.

features.name: Reusable prefabs
features.editor: Prefab creation and instantiation exist.
features.persistence: Prefab library records now persist in the project document; complete prefab tree/reference semantics remain unverified.
features.export: Not a portable prefab project library.
features.next: Recursive instances, stable references and project persistence.
features.proof: Source review; end-to-end certification pending.

features.name: Physics and joints
features.editor: Pinned Ammo initializes before application creation; physics pauses during authoring and advances in Play. Play uses disposable bodies; Stop restores the original scene.
features.persistence: Collision half-extents and zero mass/friction/restitution now round-trip; complete joint fields and semantics remain unverified.
features.export: File-menu HTML embeds the same pinned Ammo source and engine, with integrity checks and licenses.
features.next: Restore pre-play state exactly; verify constraints, terrain traversal and supported gameplay scenarios.
features.proof: Real Ammo freeze/advance tests and moved-file browser sphere-floor contact pass.

features.name: Procedural SFX and spatial sound
features.editor: Procedural SFX plus real source/slot configuration via inspector and AI exist; editor restoration stays silent until Play.
features.persistence: Declared source URLs, per-slot settings and positional component settings persist and join active-scene readiness.
features.export: Delivered scene builder binds declared slots and supplies a camera listener; audible/browser unlock testing and full dependency packaging remain pending.
features.next: Interactive playback/device tests, complete asset ownership and prefab/inactive-scene certification.
features.proof: Real engine slot/asset, readiness, failure, AI configuration, duplication and delivered-builder checks pass.

features.name: Custom script lifecycle
features.editor: Code editor, registry and attributes exist.
features.persistence: Shared script source and script attribute data now restore and survive scene switching.
features.export: Runtime injects registered script code; isolation/parity not certified.
features.next: Certify script attachment/activation lifecycle and isolate generated execution.
features.proof: Project and legacy import tests restore source without evaluating it; component attribute round-trip is tested.

features.name: Keyframe timeline

features.persistence: Panel tracks are not part of current scene document.
features.export: Timeline tracks are not a documented shared export contract.
features.next: Persist tracks and execute through shared runtime.
features.proof: Source review; end-to-end certification pending.
